features.name: Talent System
features.description: The most essential feature of Evolisca. Unlock talent pages and customize your character abilities through talents earned from outfits, mounts, auras, wings, and NPCs.
details: Unlock Page 2 with Talent Page Parchment (1,000 coins)
Unlock Page 3 via Infinity Talents Quest
Reset talents using Talent Tokens
Gain 1 talent every 25 levels
Can be removed using talent tokens from dungeons and monsters

features.name: Dungeons
features.description: Challenging dungeon encounters with 5 distinct difficulty levels. Daily dungeon allocations with unique rewards and formidable boss encounters.
details: 3 dungeons per day per player (4 with golden account)
5 distinct difficulty levels: 100, 200, 600, 1200, 1500
Each dungeon has unique rewards and a boss encounter
Dungeon tokens used to obtain items from Dungeon NPC
All dungeon charges reset at midnight server time

features.name: Task System
features.description: Progressive system of tasks that unlock as you level. Tasks provide access to boss encounters and accumulate points for boss permissions.
details: Tasks unlock at higher levels
Reset daily at 00:00 server time
Tasks starting from level 200+ offer valuable task points
Task points enable boss permissions from comprehensive boss list
All tasks now grant Star Coins and Task Points on completion

features.name: Cursed Chests
features.description: Challenging chest encounters that appear after defeating monsters. Overcome 5 waves to claim rewards.
details: Materialize upon defeating a monster
Exclusive to the player who defeated the monster
Requires overcoming 5 challenging waves
Rewards include: Star coins, currency, rare dolls, outfits, mounts

features.name: Monster Orbs
features.description: Special orbs that spawn when killing monsters. Provide temporary buffs to damage, experience, and loot.
details: Spawn when killing a monster
Only the defeating player can take the orb
Increase damage, experience, and loot for limited time
Can also give an aura to help kill the monster

features.name: Monster Skulls
features.description: Four types of skulls (white, green, red, black) that appear after killing monsters and enhance combat.
details: Four skull types: white, green, red, black
Appear after killing a monster
Each skull adds to monster's damage, health, experience, and loot

features.name: Daily Reward Quest
features.description: Daily activities with random rewards based on luck. Fight monsters and bosses for mounts, outfits, wings, auras, and currencies.
details: Go to daily reward quest every day
Fight the monster and boss
Claim your reward
Reward categories: mounts, outfits, wings, auras, shaders, birds, money, star coins, talent coins
Daily box time resets with daily quest time

features.name: Enhanced Item System (Upgrades)
features.description: Upgrade items to increase combat effectiveness. Upgrade various attributes up to level 10.
details: Upgradeable attributes: armor, defense, attack power, attack bonuses, critical hit damage, damage increase, damage reduction, dodge chance, damage penetration, life leech, mana leech
Maximum upgrade level: 10
Level of upgrades achieved is subject to luck
Bonus: +10% Damage Increase for Soul Set

features.name: Market System
features.description: Facilitates effortless buying and selling of items using money or premium points.
details: Right-click item and select Add Market
Choose currency: gold or premium points
Set length of offer
Can also buy items in stacks

features.name: Bosses and Cooldowns
features.description: Bosses spawn at regular intervals (every hour) at different locations with integrated cooldown module.
details: Bosses emerge at regular intervals
Spawn every hour at different locations
Cooldown Module integrated into game
Real-time updates on boss status and availability
Daily Boss Charges available from Grizzly Adams using Task Points
Weekly Boss events on Sunday, Friday, Saturday

features.name: Waypoints
features.description: Fast travel system with initial waypoints and ability to unlock additional locations.
details: Three initial waypoints: Temple, Tasker, Quests Room
Stand on designated waypoint tiles to unlock additional waypoints
Checkpoint on second floor of Temple
Access world map through shop

features.name: Craft System
features.description: Create items by combining ingredients. Four main craft categories available.
details: Must complete a quest to use craft machine
Categories: Utility, Ingredient, Enchants, Cosmetics
Utility: craft stones for skill and regeneration, unlimited SSA, unlimited Might Ring
Ingredient: craft ingredients for other items
Enchants: craft end-game sets
Cosmetics: craft mounts, outfits, quest items

features.name: Fish System
features.description: Sea hunting with social skills. Catch fish with special effects and bonuses.
details: Five types of fish available
Buy fishing rods from Alissa
Rods require specific skill levels and have break chance
Fish Effects: Green Perch restores mana, Northern Pike grants +5 skills, Rainbow Trout grants +10 skills, Wanda Fish grants +10% attack speed

features.name: Online Points
features.description: Earn points for online time. Use with Khlfawy NPC for rewards.
details: Earn +1 point every 30 minutes online
Use with Khlfawy NPC on 2nd floor of temple
Can be exchanged for stamina refiller

features.name: No-Bot Spawning System
features.description: Choose between normal and no-bot spawns with increased difficulty and rewards.
details: When entering hunting area, choose: Normal Spawn or No-Bot Spawn
No-Bot Spawn features: 2x monster density, expanded room layouts
Bonuses: +30% Experience, +30% Loot Chance

features.name: Set Bonuses
features.description: Complete equipment sets grant powerful bonuses to combat effectiveness.
details: Challenge Room Set: +10% Critical Chance
Raid Boss Set (Thorn Style): +5% Critical Chance, +5% Damage Increase
Soul Set: +10% Damage Increase
High-Level Set (3500+): +10% Damage Increase, +10% Critical Chance

features.name: Challenge Room System
features.description: 7-wave high-level dungeon encounters with escalating challenges and powerful rewards.
details: Minimum Level: 1500
Entry Cost: 10x Monster Skull Tokens
7 waves: Monster waves 1-2, Boss wave 3, Monster waves 4-6, Boss wave 7
Gain +1 level after each wave
Cooldown: 15 minutes to complete all 7 waves
Enter once every 5 hours

features.name: Bounce System
features.description: Weapon enhancement system for hitting multiple targets.
details: Bounce Stone: Unlocks Bounce System on weapon
Bounce Monster Stone: Increases number of targets
Bounce Stone Remover: Removes Bounce and returns stone

features.name: Recover Experience System
features.description: Recover lost experience upon death with EXP Restore Box.
details: Players can recover 25% of lost experience
EXP Restore Box appears on corpse
Only deceased player can access
Other players cannot use or remove

features.name: Spawn Parchment
features.description: Private spawn access with increased monster density and experience.
details: Cooldown reduced from 6 hours to 3 hours
1 hour private spawn with good experience
Boss appearance chance: 20%
Defeating boss: 10% chance to unlock Krakoloss mount
Eligibility: Players level 1000+

features.name: Monster Experience Scaling
features.description: Experience scales based on level difference between player and monster.
details: If higher level than monster: EXP reduced (min 50%)
If monster higher than player: EXP boosted (max 120%)

features.name: Boosted Monster System
features.description: Daily rotating boosted monsters with increased experience and loot.
details: Boosted monsters rotate daily at server save
Each day one monster is boosted
Higher Experience from boosted monster
Higher loot drop chance

features.name: PvP System
features.description: Player vs Player combat with experience enabled and balanced level scaling.
details: Experience enabled in PvP
Level range: 80% to 200%
No same IP/account abuse
Protection Zone (PZ) Lock: 1 minute
White Skull Time: 1 minute
Red Skull Length: 1 day

features.name: Buff System
features.description: Select damage, reduction, and skills buffs with duration and cooldown.
details: Select Damage, Reduction, and Skills buffs
Duration: 1 hour
Cooldown: 2 hours
Cost: Evolisca Tokens

features.name: Daily Streak
features.description: Daily experience bonus system that resets on missed days.
details: Earn EXP bonus daily (up to 10%)
Miss a day: reset
Incentivizes regular gameplay

features.name: Vocation Buffs
features.description: Class-specific buffs at various level thresholds with unique abilities.
details: Available at levels: 850, 1100, 1500, 2500
Unique abilities per class
High-risk, high-reward gameplay
Talent reduction caps by vocation: Knight max 30%, RP 25%, Mage 20%

features.name: Reward System
features.description: Minimum damage requirement for loot with bonuses and double loot chance.
details: Minimum 10% damage required for loot
Knights gain +50% bonus
Chance for double loot (top damage)
Rewards go directly to backpack
